object: Forkline Field v1.0.0, the internal multidisciplinary design constitution and representative component specimen for the Manzanita successor.
mechanism: The constitution defines one recognizable geometry-bound form language, stable typography roles, equal semantic materials, evidence symbols, source and image classes, motion semantics, content laws, and representative components. The self-contained specimen proves that aperture controls change geometry and evidence, overlay controls change registered authored geometry, actor controls change evidence and authority, and light, dark, compact, keyboard, and reduced-motion modes preserve the same content and claim boundary.

evidence.claim: Defines the complete Forkline Field identity, form, type, materials, symbols, art direction, motion, content, components, specimen contract, and authority boundary.
Classifies the object, names actors and authority, explains the mechanism, carries the public and constitutional holds, and defines operation and succession.
Provides the accessible self-contained representative composition, authored-data labels, source rail, actor branch, failure sheet, and handoff receipt.
Implements equal light and dark materials, typography roles, geometry-bound visual grammar, compact behavior, focus, reduced motion, forced colors, and print.
Implements actual aperture, overlay, actor, and theme state changes without network requests or unlabeled source substitution.
Checks constitution completeness, geometry law, type and material parity, source classes, controls, self-containment, contrast, forbidden shortcuts, and task boundaries.

Exercises four viewports, light and dark captures, first-visit Auto behavior, reduced motion, keyboard controls, geometry changes, actor semantics, source visibility, overflow, errors, and external requests.
Retains the exact browser campaign, screenshot digests, state-mechanism results, errors, external-request results, and internal-candidate boundary.
Binds static, browser, contained-board, bounded-diff, and artifact-retention checks to the submitted pull-request head.
Defines the twelve contained discipline seats, evidence minimums, veto law, decision states, and non-authority boundary used for this review.

claim_boundary: This packet requests internal admission of the design constitution and representative components only. It does not request qualification of the historical public route, the integrated source foundation as a product, seven production apertures, eight live overlays, five operating seats, provider operations, household or field action, a public endpoint, a design score, canonical task-count mutation, or any external effect.

object_classification.reason: The object is explicitly classified as an internal multidisciplinary design constitution and representative specimen rather than a product or release.

actors_and_authority.reason: The design integrator, separate review seats, release authority, successor product teams, and cold successor have explicit and bounded duties.

mechanism_fidelity.reason: The machine constitution, specimen, controls, static tests, and browser campaign implement recognizable form, real state changes, source classes, authority, and failure semantics.

source_and_authorship_custody.reason: Every specimen object is visibly classified as estate-authored demonstration geometry, repository paths are retained, and observed or provider claims are expressly prohibited.

interaction_semantics.reason: Aperture controls change geometry, evidence reading, transform, coverage, uncertainty, and claim boundary; actor controls change evidence, action, authority, acceptance, and handoff.

visual_and_typographic_finish.reason: The specimen applies one recognizable Forkline grammar, explicit type roles, equal semantic light and dark materials, non-color evidence states, and full-state captures across four widths.

motion_and_temporal_continuity.reason: State, scale, source, registration, and handoff motion semantics and reduced-motion equivalents are defined and tested, while production motion choreography and real temporal data remain later objects.

responsive_and_accessible_operation.reason: The browser campaign covers desktop, laptop, mobile, compact, keyboard group navigation, visible source rails, no horizontal overflow, dark and light parity, and reduced motion.

performance_resilience_and_failure.reason: The specimen is local, static, self-contained, network-independent, and tested for errors and failure copy, while production budgets, low-end devices, provider outages, and rollback remain outside this object.

security_privacy_rights_and_purpose.reason: The specimen contains no private household payload, credential, provider media, or external request and visibly prohibits inspection, adverse action, public release, and unlabeled source substitution.

continuity_export_rollback_and_successio.reason: Repository-local constitution, specimen, tests, commands, screenshots, and receipts support cold replay, while integration into production components and eventual rollback campaigns remain later work.

qualification_receipts_and_public_effect.reason: The exact-head workflow retains static, browser, board, screenshot, and digest evidence while the packet requests internal design-constitution authority and no public or constitutional-count effect.

board_chair: Confirm exact evidence coverage, requested internal authority, partial gates, holds, bounded diff, and the absence of a hidden product, public, or constitutional-count claim.
creative_direction: Determine whether Forkline Field is recognizable from an unlabeled fragment, whether its natural-border language follows the represented geometry, and whether the specimen avoids generic dashboard grammar.
product_interaction: Confirm that aperture, overlay, actor, and theme controls change the declared operating state and never substitute labels or crops for a functional change.
information_design: Confirm that actor, object, source, time, mechanism, uncertainty, authority, safe action, prohibited effect, and receipt remain legible across dense and compact states.
typography: Review the declared display, editorial, operational, label, data, and compact roles for optical coherence, fallback behavior, zoom, and narrow-width survival.
motion: Review whether state transitions carry scale, source, registration, or handoff meaning and whether reduced motion preserves identical before-and-after information.
source_custody: Confirm that all specimen geometry is visibly authored, every source class has a claim and substitution boundary, and unavailable evidence cannot become a positive observation.
field_operations: Confirm that resident, steward, and planner branches distinguish household care, bounded verification, and program coordination without claiming entry, inspection, work, or completion authority.
accessibility: Review keyboard operation, visible focus, non-color state symbols, compact width, zoom-resilient structure, reduced motion, forced colors, and equivalent source and authority meaning.
performance_resilience: Confirm self-contained operation, no external requests, zero console and page errors, no overflow, static failure utility, and explicit holds for production performance and provider resilience.
security_privacy: Confirm the absence of private data and secrets, visible authored-state labels, purpose limits, adverse-action prohibition, and no external communication or provider commitment.
continuity_release: Confirm that a cold successor can reproduce the constitution, browser campaign, screenshots, board decision, and rollback boundary without presenting internal admission as public release.

prohibited_uses: insurance denial, underwriting, premium setting, coverage triage, or parcel-risk scoring
property valuation, resident ranking, enforcement, inspection, eligibility, or punitive action
field entry, labor dispatch, provider purchase, external communication, or public release
presentation of authored or generated imagery as observed place evidence
adverse_action_boundary.required_human_control: Any later external effect requires a separate source-backed object, lawful authority, named accountable human decision, specific consent or program authority, and an independently reviewable receipt.

continuity.recovery_path: Clone the exact branch or admitted commit, run the static and browser campaigns, rebuild the contained board receipt, and compare source, screenshot, state, and receipt digests.
continuity.successor_test: A cold successor must reproduce every full-state capture and refusal boundary, then use the constitution to author a new component without altering its source, authority, or evidence-class laws.

control_question: Can this design constitution govern later Manzanita production because its exact specimen proves recognizable authorship, operational state change, source custody, accessibility, and authority boundaries without borrowing standing from a public product or release?
